title: Dock pins: editors and alacritty break on an empty dock
objective:
The `editors` and `alacritty` dock pins write `@as [, '<app>.desktop']` on an empty dock, and gsettings refuses it. `vscode` handles the empty list (`@as []`). Give both the same case. `editors` also ignores a failed `molt_gsettings set` and still says it added Emacs: make it name the failure (`editors.sh:263-265`, `alacritty.sh:106`).

Four liberators write GNOME's dock favourites: `desktop`, `vscode`, `editors` and `alacritty`. They do not conflict on kovacs today. Give the favourites one writer.
